race.comment: PATRIKA EXPRESS (6) has done little wrong in two starts, winning her Mdn at Dubbo by just over four lengths before being run down late as a dominant odds-on favourite in a BM58 at Orange. Gets some weight relief here and a softer barrier is a big tick. Can get back to winning ways. BLUE AKOYA (2) has placed or finished close in both runs this campaign in BM66 grade. Third-up now and the form out of her last start has held up well. Can put her best foot forward. TRAVELON DORY (5) is on the quick turnaround after a nice win last start and can't be left out. SHYAMALAN (3) dipped before the break but was racing well without winning prior to that. Can feature first-up.
